identity.name: Llama3.1-SuperDeepFuse-CrashCourse12K
identity.summary: An 8B-parameter instruction-tuned language model built by fine-tuning Llama3.1-SuperDeepFuse on the agentlans/crash-course dataset.

possible_risks.description: Lack of model transparency is due to insufficient documentation of the model design, development, and evaluation process and the absence of insights into the inner workings of the model.
possible_risks.justification: Card gives only architecture, LoRA/4-bit/NEFTune/RS-LoRA adaptation, and dataset name; no design/evaluation details or inner-workings insights for this checkpoint.

possible_risks.description: Lack of data transparency might be due to insufficient documentation of training or tuning dataset details, including synthetic data generation.
possible_risks.justification: Card names the crash-course dataset but does not document its collection, curation, composition, or any synthetic generation details.

possible_risks.description: Data provenance refers to the traceability of data (including synthetic data), which includes its ownership, origin, transformations, and generation. Proving that the data is the same as the original source with correct usage terms is difficult without standardized methods for verifying data sources or generation.
possible_risks.justification: Open-weight checkpoint fine-tuned on an external named dataset with no stated ownership, origin, transformations, or usage terms for that data.

possible_risks.description: Since foundation models can be used for many purposes, a model's intended use is important for defining the relevant risks of that model. As the use changes, the relevant risks might correspondingly change.
possible_risks.justification: Card only says 'instruction-tuned language model' and gives no intended-use or out-of-scope use definition, so relevant risks are not defined.

specifications.model_size: 15.0 GiB of safetensors weights (16,060,556,376 bytes) in BF16

training_context.adaptations: The model was further fine-tuned using LoRA with 4-bit quantization (bitsandbytes), NEFTune (noise alpha: 5), and RS-LoRA.
